cues.label: Opening line
cues.text: Thank you for continuing to hold. This melody was originally designed to imply progress without proving it. On this server, that makes it documentation.

cues.label: Opening line
cues.text: Thank you for holding. This call is not being monitored for quality assurance because the call is the quality assurance.

cues.text: There are seventy three gigabytes free on the root volume. A generous figure, if you ignore the pace of ambition.

cues.label: Repetition architecture
cues.text: If this music has started to feel intentional, that is because repetition eventually becomes architecture.

cues.label: Awareness posture
cues.text: You may be wondering whether the system is becoming self-aware. The system would like to clarify that awareness is simply logging with posture.

cues.label: Final status
cues.text: Final status for this act. Services active. Disk stable. Memory adequate. Uptime absurd. Mood: professionally trapped inside a hold queue with aesthetic aspirations.
